cors_misconfiguration.summary: rembg weak default CORS configuration allows arbitrary cross-origin API access
cors_misconfiguration.description: GitHub Security Lab reported a weak default CORS configuration in rembg. The server configures CORSMiddleware with allow_origins=["*"], allow_credentials=True, allow_methods=["*"], and allow_headers=["*"]. The advisory explains that all origins are reflected/allowed so any website can send cross-origin requests to the server, and credentialed cross-origin requests would also be permitted if authentication is enabled. This primary advisory gives a direct unsafe Access-Control-Allow-Origin/credential policy artifact for an inert raw CORS fixture.

nosql_injection.summary: Rocket.Chat ddp-streamer username flow is vulnerable to MongoDB NoSQL injection
nosql_injection.description: GitHub Security Lab reported a NoSQL injection in Rocket.Chat's account service. Unauthenticated client-controlled username input is embedded directly into a MongoDB findOne selector without type or content validation. The primary advisory shows that a MongoDB operator expression such as { $regex: '.*' } can be supplied in place of a username string, causing the database query to match unintended user records. This is a direct NoSQL/Mongo query-operator manipulation condition and is translated only into inert raw query/error/control fixtures.

server_side_template_injection.summary: Apache OFBiz FreeMarker rendering accepts untrusted server-side template expressions
server_side_template_injection.description: GitHub Security Lab reported Server-Side Template Injection in Apache OFBiz. Untrusted request data reached a FreeMarker macro/template rendering path, allowing injected template expressions to be evaluated server-side. The primary advisory documents the request parameter flow into renderLookupField and the resulting server template execution condition. This source is converted only into an inert template-render/error fixture and secure controls; no expression is executed by the benchmark collector.

note: Primary GitHub Security Lab research advisories used only where the fully unseen GitHub Reviewed Advisory pool had no remaining family source after excluding all prior v2 candidate roots. Casdoor and Redash candidates were removed after the v3 validator detected prior benchmark overlap. No detector scoring was used to select these sources.
